name: travel-itinerary
description: Turn a trip plan sheet into a printable day-by-day itinerary, a calendar file for your phone and a bookings list. Every time is read in its own time zone (Asia/Tokyo, UTC+9 or just 东京), so flight durations, home time and calendar entries come out right across borders. Catches the mistakes that ruin a trip: a flight with no arrival time zone that shifts the rest of the trip, arrivals before departures, overlapping plans, too little time before a flight or between places, nights with nowhere to stay or two hotels on one night, stays without a check-out date, unreadable times like 19:3O and missing booking refs. Exports a PDF itinerary with times, addresses and booking refs per day plus a bookings page, an .ics calendar (stays as all-day spans, reminders before flights and trains) and an Excel itinerary. No account or API keys; runs on your computer.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把行程表变成按天排好的可打印行程单、可导入手机的日历文件和预订汇总。每个时间都按各自时区读取（Asia/Tokyo、UTC+9 或直接写“东京”），跨国航班的时长、家里时间和日历时间都对得上。会发现最容易坏事的错误：航班没写到达时区导致后面行程全错一小时、到达早于出发、安排时间重叠、航班前或换地点时间不够、某晚没有住处或订了两家酒店、住宿缺退房日期、19:3O 这类读不懂的时间、缺预订号。导出按天列出时间、地址、预订号的 PDF 行程单（附预订汇总页）、.ics 日历（住宿为全天跨天事件，航班火车前提醒）和 Excel 行程表。不用登录，无需 API 密钥，本机运行。
